name: Laiba
greetingText: Some people make life a little brighter just by being a part of it. You’re one of them. 🤍
wishText: May Allah bless your life with endless happiness, peace, success, and beautiful moments. May every difficult path become easier, every sincere prayer find its way to you, and every new chapter bring you closer to the life you dream of. May you always have reasons to smile, people who truly value you, and a heart full of peace. Ameen. 🤲🏻✨
text1: Today is all about celebrating YOU. 🎂✨
textInChatBox: Happy Birthday, Laiba! 🎉 This little surprise is just a small reminder of how special you are. Wishing you a beautiful year filled with happiness, growth, laughter, and unforgettable memories. 🤍
text2: I wanted to give you something meaningful...
text3: Something you could keep as a little memory. ✨
text4: So I put a few heartfelt words together,
text5Content: the simplest wishes come from the heart. 🤍
outroText: May this new chapter of your life be softer, brighter, and more beautiful than the last. Keep smiling, keep growing, and always stay true to yourself. Happy Birthday once again! 🎂🤍
replayText: Want to relive the little surprise? ✨ Play it again. 💕
